findings.check: k=F2; G=constant U5(F2), X=BG. h=[I+E12,I+E23]=I+E13 and v=[I+E34,I+E45]=I+E35 lie in G', but [h,v]=I+E15 != I. Thus kernel of suspension G→G_ab is nonabelian and cannot be the image of the abelian sheaf pi2(X smash X).
findings.all_hypotheses: Finite 2-group is unipotent in characteristic 2; BG pointed connected affine; every cohomology degree finite by finite-group bar complex; n=0 satisfies connectivity.
findings.dependency: Explicitly used in boundary case of principal Freudenthal Theorem1.0.16 through Proposition3.4.10.

findings.repair: Restrict EHP group sequence to positive connectivity; replace n=0 paragraph by complete universal-property proof in report.

focused_acceptance.reason: For X=BG with G the constant U_5(F_2) in characteristic 2, G is a finite unipotent group, BG is a connected affine stack under the cited characterization, and each H^i(BG,O) is finite-dimensional. At n=0 the printed group-sheaf exact sequence (3.4.4) on PDF page 37 would make the nonabelian commutator subgroup G' an image of the abelian group pi_2(X smash X). Explicitly [I+e12,I+e23]=I+e13, [I+e34,I+e45]=I+e35, and [I+e13,I+e35]=I+e15!=I. Thus G' is nonabelian and the claimed bilinear commutator description cannot hold. This invalidates an expressly used core proof step and remains Major even though the n=0 conclusion is restored by the universal property [U(Sigma X),K(H,2)]_*=[X,BH]_*=Hom(G,H), giving affine abelianization and its quotient map. This repair is conditional on the named framework and does not certify all foundations.
